nodes.title: 共享负面提示词 (FLUX 留空)
天赋节点批量出图说明 (共16张)
widgets_values:
■ 工作流: 天赋节点图标批量生成 (FLUX)
   一次 Queue Prompt 出全部 16 张
   预计耗时 85-100 分钟 (M4 Pro)

■ 天赋序列 (圆角方形金边外框):
   行1 攻势 1-4 sharp_edge/lethal_strike/
                 five_element_sword/soul_render
   行2 守护 5-8 jade_body/qi_barrier/
                 elements_harmony/immortal_body
   行3 辅助 9-12 inner_circulation/healing_hand/
                  perception_expand/divination
   行4 修身 13-16 great_fortune/epiphany_seeker/
                   firm_heart/longevity

■ 风格一致性:
   - 共享 seed 88888888 (fixed)
   - 共享 EmptyLatent 1024x1024
   - 圆角方形外框 (与 Buff 圆形/Debuff 棱形可盲识区分)

■ 输出 (每张 2 份):
   output/wuxia_talent_1024/[name].png  (1024 母版)
   output/wuxia_talent_128/[name].png   (128 游戏图标)

■ 命名规范 (与 talent-system 对齐):
   talent_icon_[name].png
   由 import_ai_assets.sh 自动回流到
   assets/ui/talent_icons/

■ 单张重抽:
   1. 找到该图标的 KSampler 节点
   2. seed 改成别的数 (如 88888889)
   3. control_after_generate 暂改 randomize
   4. 单独 Queue Prompt 重抽
   5. 满意后改回 fixed

■ 注意:
   FLUX 对圆角方形外框较稳, 但若个别图崩坏可单抽
   实际渲染 64x64, 1024 母版仅作备份

nodes.title: 1. talent_icon_sharp_edge - 正面
widgets_values: A minimalist game UI talent icon for a cultivation wuxia RPG, centered composition. Subject: a single jade green sword half drawn from its sheath in the center, the exposed blade tip shimmering with pale gold luster against a faint warm red inner glow. The subject occupies about 70 percent of the canvas in the center, with generous empty space around. Behind the subject is a complete unbroken single closed rounded square border drawn as a uniform thin gold line, the square has gently rounded corners, perfectly symmetric on both axes, no decoration on the border itself. Pure clean solid white background, no other elements. Flat vector illustration style, painted with traditional Chinese ink wash brushstrokes but extremely simplified for icon use. cool jade green steel and pale gold gleam with faint warm red glow color palette only. No realistic human portraits, only stylized silhouettes if any, no facial features, no complex patterns, no maze patterns, no ornate frames, no text, no chinese characters, no multiple subjects, no snowflakes on border, no debris on border, no asymmetric elements, no broken frame. Single focal point on the central subject. Designed to be readable when scaled down to 64x64 pixels. Symmetric and balanced composition. Highest quality concept art for game UI.
